title: Insert-layer choice guard (HandlerLogicError) has no test and is unreachable from the test surface
detail: The spec's loud-abort guard for a validate_form bypass sits in private fn insert_application_row (line 1649), so no test module can call it and validate_form blocks every request-level path. The defence-in-depth branch is verified by inspection only.
recommended_fix: Accept as inspection-verified, or extract the choice check into a pub helper so a unit test can pin the Error branch directly.

title: Overlong-header truncation test exercises only single-codepoint inputs
detail: Both adversarial headers are ASCII repeats, so the grapheme-slice vs Postgres length() mismatch this PR's own deferred-work.md entry documents (multi-codepoint header can exceed the CHECK post-slice and 500) is not exercised by any test.
recommended_fix: When the deferred codepoint-bounded slicing fix lands, add a multi-codepoint header case (e.g. repeated emoji/accented chars) asserting length() stays within 64/512.

title: error_summary label "Contacting your referees" for reference_contact_choice is unpinned
detail: error_summary_test.gleam pins curated labels and runs a fall-through drift guard over a key list, but reference_contact_choice appears in neither; deleting the base_label entry would silently degrade the banner to "Reference contact choice".
recommended_fix: Add label_for("reference_contact_choice") |> should.equal("Contacting your referees") to error_summary_test.gleam and include the key in the curated-keys drift list.

title: Advisory test gate: PASS
detail: P0 100% (attested/declined/missing-choice each have unit+integration tests; IP/UA bounded asserted at 64/512). P1 ~95% (tampered validation, codec Some/None/absent-key round-trips, detail-row mapping, DSAR keys, migration-from-reset via integration suite all covered). Overall >90%; only P3 gaps (untestable insert guard, multi-codepoint truncation, label pin). No weakened assertions: ack-count tests keep exact 2/3/3 per-type pins with fixture defaulted to declined.
recommended_fix: Gate already passes; filing the three note-level pins (label test, multi-codepoint case with the deferred fix, extracted guard helper) would close residual drift risk.
